faqs.question: What are the hostel charges at Ambedkar University Delhi, Karampura?
faqs.answer: Students seeking to enroll into AUD Karampura can choose to avail the accommodation benefit provided by the university. The hostel fees at Ambedkar University Delhi, Karampura is INR 51,000, which includes the one-time security fees of INR 10,000. Students choosing to receive the hostel mess facility would be required to pay an amount of 19,200 per semester (plus INR 1,000 maintenance fee).

college_info.intro:
Ambedkar University Delhi courses at the Karampura campus are influenced more strongly towards the Humanities subjects. The popular programs at Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University, Karampura include the large variety of BA courses. These courses are offered in various disciplines like English, Mathematics, History, Sociology, Social Sciences and Humanities, among others.
Also popular among the UG courses are BBA, BVoc, and the Integrated Teacher Education Programs (ITEP). Along with the undergraduate programs, the faculty at AUD Karampura also offers a variety of PG and PhD programs.

reviews_list.review_title: The first thing I liked about the university is the faculty,

review_content.Placements: Students become eligible for placements from their 3rd year. The highest package: is 44 LPA, and the average package is 6-7 LPA. 80% of students got placed in a product-based company, like Flipkart, or Amazon.
review_content.Infrastructure: The overall experience of my campus life is good. The infrastructure is good with ACs all over the campus which gives great relief in summer. The university should focus more on funding the societies and clubs of the college and also on sports things.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.A. in Law and Politics - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: From quiet halls to DIY fun.

review_content.Placements: The placement cell is now being made by the college for our course. Despite making a committee, there are no internships provided by the committee. You can easily get an internship as a paralegal under an advocate while or after completing is degree. You can also work in policy-making and work as a think tank.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of course for law and politics is well-planned and student-friendly. It is a multidisciplinary course and it focuses on both law and politics. The quality of hostel is not that great, in addition to that there are very reserved seats for enrollment in the hostel.

reviews_list.batch_info: M.A. in Law, Politics and Society - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Satisfied with college. Course curriculum is good and practical.

review_content.Placements: Since this is a new course that is being introduced by the BR Ambedkar College. My course name is M.A. in public policy and governance. It is the first batch in this college. There are no placements. But the top roles that are offered in our course are for policy-making decisions and for posts in government offices like Niti Aayog.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure at this college is average. They have a playground and canteen. It is quite decent and the rooms are filled are ventilated by AC. But the chair could use some improvements otherwise the infrastructure is good. The food quality in the canteen is hygienic.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Voc. in Accounting & Finance - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: If you want to take opportunity of internship I've said above then definitely go for it.

review_content.Placements: This is a course where you learn the B.Com (Hons) syllabus but in a practical way, which means this college will provide an internship under CAs, which means you should do an internship of 2 months after completion of the 1st year, and it's compulsory. If you don't do it, they can't provide your degree to you at the end of the 3rd year.
review_content.Infrastructure: There is only hostel facility for girls, so I don't know much, but my friends said that they are good and means easy to survive. And the main thing, the food is good, and the availability of the library, which is I guess the best facility they provide. I can't talk about their Wi-Fi because it has much lower speeds.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.A. in Law and Politics - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Journey of Ups and Downs - "College Life"

review_content.Placements: There is no as such placement cell in our campus but the faculty is very good and we are also taught about Interdisciplinary course. They sometimes offer internship. The students have to find out companies and field from themselves only. The college doesn't provide placement.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of my college is very good with ac's all around the campus which gives relief from scorching heat in the summers. The college also provides Wifi system. The hostel facility is not that good of the college and the university needs to look into this matter as it is a concern.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.A. in Law and Politics - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Ambedkar University has no social life.

review_content.Placements: There is a newly formed placement committee at our campus, and placement coordinators have been chosen, but yet they haven't provided internships to students. Although for my course you can easily get an internship under a lawyer as a paralegal, after completion of this course students can get a job with a 2-3 LPA, which is pretty decent for a bachelor's degree.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is pretty good with smart classes. The college library is also good, but the mess of the college is in very poor condition, and the food is hygienic and very expensive. There are only hostel facilities for girls, and boys have to stay in PGs nearby the college, which are costly if you don't have a roommate to share the burden.

reviews.review_heading: The first thing I liked about the university is the faculty,
reviews.review_text: The overall experience of my campus life is good. The infrastructure is good with ACs all over the campus which gives great relief in summer. The university should focus more on funding the societies and clubs of the college and also on sports things.

reviews.review_heading: From quiet halls to DIY fun.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of course for law and politics is well-planned and student-friendly. It is a multidisciplinary course and it focuses on both law and politics. The quality of hostel is not that great, in addition to that there are very reserved seats for enrollment in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with college. Course curriculum is good and practical.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure at this college is average. They have a playground and canteen. It is quite decent and the rooms are filled are ventilated by AC. But the chair could use some improvements otherwise the infrastructure is good. The food quality in the canteen is hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: If you want to take opportunity of internship I've said above then definitely go for it.
reviews.review_text: There is only hostel facility for girls, so I don't know much, but my friends said that they are good and means easy to survive. And the main thing, the food is good, and the availability of the library, which is I guess the best facility they provide. I can't talk about their Wi-Fi because it has much lower speeds.

reviews.review_heading: Journey of Ups and Downs - "College Life"
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of my college is very good with ac's all around the campus which gives relief from scorching heat in the summers. The college also provides Wifi system. The hostel facility is not that good of the college and the university needs to look into this matter as it is a concern.

reviews.review_heading: Ambedkar University has no social life.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is pretty good with smart classes. The college library is also good, but the mess of the college is in very poor condition, and the food is hygienic and very expensive. There are only hostel facilities for girls, and boys have to stay in PGs nearby the college, which are costly if you don't have a roommate to share the burden.

reviews.review_heading: Baba Sahib would have needed therapy after SEE the state of AUD.
reviews.review_text: The only reason why I am giving a rating of 3 is because the college infrastructure is not that bad. In fact, one could say it is good. But the hostel, oh my god, it's ridiculously bad. In my opinion, the college is getting the funds it needs, but the management is not utilizing it well.

reviews.review_heading: Depressing environment and sensitive professors.
reviews.review_text: Until last month, the women's washroom was dirty, and the mirror on the bathroom wall was broken. It has been repaired. The chairs are of good quality, and there is AC in all classrooms and the library, and a cooler in the canteen. The food available in the canteen is limited and depends on the mood of the canteen person (whether to make it or not; no proper menu).

reviews.review_heading: A cooperative faculty and a nice growing institute towards a brighter future.
reviews.review_text: The faculty is quite good, which is one of the major attractions of both the course and the university. The faculty members are very cooperative and available to help students throughout. The infrastructure is also decent in terms of maintenance, classroom facilities, security, etc. I am unaware of the hostel facilities as I live in an individual flat of my own.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, B.R. Ambedkar University in Delhi is good for higher studies as it is a state university.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the Karampura campus of B.R. Ambedkar University is good. They provide Wi-Fi, a reading room, a library, a lab and sports grounds. The hostel is only for girls where the mess is currently close and the fee is affordable. The campus environment is satisfactory, and the crowd is limited.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good infrastructure and helpful teachers but placements are not good.
reviews.review_text: Our college has air-conditioned classrooms, 2 good IT labs, and Wi-Fi. All classrooms have projectors and whiteboards. There is a nice library with a study area. Canteen food is okay, not that good. There is a medical room. Sports like TT, football, and badminton are available. There is a big ground for football with greenery on campus. It is an open environment with a good crowd.

reviews.review_heading: In our college, the admission process is very easy.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, laboratory, classrooms, and library facilities are good. This is a government university.

reviews.review_heading: A very good faculty, infrastructure, and facilities, and is growing every year.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms, libraries, and labs all have centralized air-conditioners. The maintenance and cleanliness of all the rooms are very good. The sports and other facilities are very good, however, the canteen food is average. The hostel facilities are only for and only if you belong outside NCT.

reviews.review_heading: Good option for students still figuring it out.
reviews.review_text: While there are facilities like computer labs, free Wi-Fi, and a library available. The state of the bathrooms and basic hygiene requirements were not MET. The toilets are unkept with clogged sinks and no cold water for drinking during the summer. Sports however is taken seriously and there are several clubs for the same.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with its course and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this college is basic and minimal like other government colleges. The classrooms are well-furnished with decent benches, a projector, fan, and air-conditioner. Wi-Fi is also available. Computer laboratories are also open for all students to access digital libraries, etc. The library also has a decent amount of books for the courses provided in our college. The hostel of the KP campus has not re-opened yet due to covid.

review_summary.college_name: KK Modi University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: A review from a student.

content.Placements: The average package for our college is around 8 LPA, and the highest package goes to 12 LPA. According to me, I see more than 70 to 80% of my seniors got placements. The placements in companies such as Colorbar, Indofil Industries, Godfrey Philips India Ltd, and many more in every field.
content.Infrastructure: Our college infrastructure is hi-tech and totally updated with safety checks. The college environment is too friendly. I don't have any experience of hostel life. For the sports and games, we have pool table, table tennis, volleyball field, badminton field, and many things are under construction.

individual_reviews.course: BCA in Data Analytics - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: KKMU life and overview.

content.Placements: I am 2023 batch. I am doing BCA in Data Analytics from KK Modi University. I have learned about programming languages, OOPS, Algorithms, My SQL, etc. Around 28 students are there in batch 2023, and I will complete my degree in 2026, and we are going for internships also in next 5th semester.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of our university is very good compared to the other colleges. Only from a distance we can see the difference between our university and other colleges regarding infrastructure. All the things are there like Wi-Fi, tables, cafeteria, sports, games, and many more.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: The thing that summarizes my college review would be the college like never before.

content.Placements: Well, I had no information about the same thing since I am not away and I had not talked to others about the same thing. I definitely mention the moment I get it. The recruiting companies were the based ones the high wheel maximum package was around 5 LPA, and I am not aware of the other ones my college comes under tier 3 categories. I think such things won't be the point to consider like the top recruiting companies and basically, every student got the internships and industrial experience.
content.Infrastructure: In our college, we had great and wonderful infrastructure. Wi-Fi was available, and we had a dedicated life for computer students. We had a classroom suitable for students up to 30. There was a library and tables were installed over there.

individual_reviews.course: B.Com. (Hons.) in Accounts - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: A Day in My College Life.

content.Placements: The highest average package that our university has provided is above 18 Lacs and the lowest package is about 2 to 5 Lacs. The top recruiting companies for our course are Apply Legal and other CA firms. Almost all the students got the internship programme.
content.Infrastructure: The hostels provided by our college are very clean and hygienic and the location is very good. As all the other shops are easily accessible from that location and it’s safe. Measures and canteen facilities are also available for sports and games. The quality of the food is also good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Com. (Hons.) in Accounts - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Really good infrastructure.

content.Placements: The B.Com batch we have to do internship in CA firm because of the subject and the highest package the university provided is above 18 lakh and top recruiting companies are CA firms like Apply Legal, Motilal Oswal. All the students almost get the internship programme.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel is pretty good and comfortable too and also the arrangements are good. We receive good facilities but we have food issues because mess food is not that good. Also, we face several issues with food. The canteen is good and also we have the pool, carrom, TT, and many types of games available.

admission_overview.description: KK Modi University admission is currently open. The university offers admission to candidates based on their merit or entrance exam scores. The university conducts KKMU Admission Test to shortlist candidates for specific courses. KKMU offers courses, such as BTech (CS) certification, BBA, MCA, MBA, MTech etc., at the UG and PG level. Apart from the UG and PG courses, the university also offers doctorate, diploma and PG diploma courses. To get admission to KK Modi University, candidates must meet the eligibility criteria set by the university. The university offers more than 15 courses (including specialisations) in various streams such as Engineering, Design, Management, Commerce etc. The application process at KK Modi University is conducted online.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Elementary Education (D.EL.ED.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: This university helps every middle class student and gives them the right education.

content.Placements: There are many students placed in various institutes. The highest placement package is 5 LPA and the lowest placement package is 1 LPA. There are many institutional visits yearly, etc. Every student can do an internship as they want and apply where they choose.
content.Infrastructure: There are many facilities available on the campus, and for each department, every classroom has Wi-Fi. There are labs for each department. Classrooms are very big and well-furnished. There are certified and digital libraries and every department has a separate library and the sitting area is good. There are good quality facilities in the hostel. The food quality is like home. There is a hospital also available on campus. There are also many sports grounds like cricket, football, volleyball, badminton and indoor games also available like table tennis, chess and many others.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure and the highest package is about 2 crores. There is a good placement ratio.

content.Placements: This university has a great placement ratio of 99.99%. Many companies visit and take placements of students. In my course, Cipla, Sunpharma, and many top companies visit the university. All students have 100% done their internship. In the last year, 26 LPA was the highest package, and the lowest was 8 LPA. This is a very good ratio for all of these courses.
content.Infrastructure: There is strong Wi-Fi connectivity. There are new and highly equipped labs. All classrooms are good. There is a smart board in every class. There is a certified library. The hostel is very clean and hygienic. The food quality is very good, with an FSO-certified mess. There is a hospital. There are many playgrounds for different games, and indoor games are also available.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: There is a very good faculty and better placement than other universities and it is very cheap.

content.Placements: In my college, approximately 60 to 70% of students are placed every year. The highest package is 50 LPA, and the lowest is 3 LPA to 4 LPA. Every 3rd year, students get a chance to work as interns from our college. In this college, new courses are also offered, and they prepared us for the interview.
content.Infrastructure: There are many classrooms and labs. There is also library in which we study from morning to evening at 8 o'clock. There are very good facilities in our hostel. There are many available sports like volleyball, football, badminton, cricket, chess, kho, kabaddi, and many more. Mess is also very good, and food quality is good.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: I am disappointed with their placement promises.

content.Placements: Placements in this college are very bad. In my batch time, only 2 pharma companies from Gujarat came to my college, and they collected resumes only. They did not provide any placements. At the start of the course, the college talked a lot about their placement partner, but at last, no placement companies came to this college.
content.Infrastructure: Actually, the college infrastructure is very good. Hostels are also good, but the food quality is not good. Classrooms are very good. Labs are also good for experiments, and the library is very well-managed. For all departments, a separate library is available.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: I am always thankful to my college, which gives me a better platform for my future.

content.Placements: Every year, about 70-80% of students get placed in the top companies like Cadila, Zydus, Macleods, Helios, and Claroid Cipla. Students get paced with the salary package that ranges from 4-5 LPA. Almost 100% of students got internships after completing their courses. Sometimes in mid-sessions, students get placed in MNC companies.
content.Infrastructure: Good labs and library facilities are available. Wi-Fi facilities are available in the hostel and library also. Hot water is also available in the hostel during the winter season. The environment of my college is evergreen. Separate boys and girls hostels are available. Mess is well-mannered. The food of the mess is awesome.

hostel.description:
No. of rooms are 480 & Room Type is Four student each room and Capacity is: 2300.

The hostels provide several sports facilities for its inmates, which include badminton, basketball, volleyball, cricket and indoor games such as table tennis, and chess. In order to ensure physical as well as spiritual fitness for its future professionals, the hostellers are provided with a gymnasium. Besides, yoga and meditation classes are held on a daily basis.

To improve the learning process, the management has provided extended access to the library and computer centre, with all the essential software loaded as per the curriculum. The University also takes due care to protect the religious, cultural and social beliefs of the students. Each festival is celebrated with full fervour and enthusiasm.

In order to accommodate students coming from far-off places, the University provides separate air-cooled hostel facilities for boys and girls within the campus. The University has its own fleet of transport and ensures safe commuting between the city and campus, with vehicles plying at reasonable intervals. Right now there are 2000 boys in four hostel and 500 girls are in two hostel.

Under this scholarship scheme, students with 85% and above marks in Class 12 are exempted from paying 25% of their tuition fee

overview_faqs.question: Is Jagannath Community College a good college/Institute?
overview_faqs.answer: Jagannath Community College is a reputed institute for Certificate, B.Voc, UG Diploma, BBA, BBM/BMS, BCA, M.Sc., B.Sc., B.Des, MBA/PGDM, B.A. (Hons), B.Com, B.FTech, BHM, M.A. Students can opt these programs to pursue their career in Medicine & Health Sciences, Business & Management Studies, Banking, Finance & Insurance, Hospitality & Travel, Design, IT & Software, Science, Accounting & Commerce, Engineering, Mass Communication & Media, Humanities & Social Sciences, Architecture & Planning. Institute has trained & experienced faculty who deliver these programs. Jagannath Community College has a review rating of 3.2 on the basis of reviews by students. In addition to this, it has been rated 3 on campuslife, 2.9 on placements, 3.8 on faculty and 3.4 on Infrastructure.

review_summary.college_name: Jagannath Community College Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.A. (Hons.) in Psychology - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: The faculty is good, the management could be better, but it's okay otherwise.

content.Placements: They didn't offer placements for fields of psychology except industrial, which I didn't take, so I didn't know much about it. But internships provided by the college were good, valuable, and really knowledgeable, they lasted for over a month, so according to that, it was good.
content.Infrastructure: Labs, library, air-conditioned classes, computer labs, and canteens were available. Washrooms were hygienic too. However, the campus was a bit small, so there was no place to hang out as such, and they didn't let you sit in the garden area or canteens if you had a free lecture. Entry and exit rules were also a bit strict.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: It is a good college for a degree only.

content.Placements: Placements of this college are not so bad or not so good. As a student of this college, I came to know that the placements are not for all the students, and these are for only those who secured a good CGP in exams or the attendance criteria are fulfilled for 75%. No big companies came here. The average package ranges from 3-4 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The college has quite good infrastructure. There are good and maintained library and computer labs. The college campus has its own 3 canteens, and the lunch facility for hostel students is different. Classes are fully AC and clean. The college has a small area for playing outdoor games.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. (Hons.) in English Literature - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Great opportunities are given to students.

content.Placements: The majority of my seniors went for proper internships where they were getting paid. Recruiting companies are Muskurahat Foundation, Project Guru, etc. I'll be currently going for my summer internships, so I would not be the best person to speak on placements.
content.Infrastructure: They have well-built classrooms and infrastructure is fine. The quality of food in the canteen is also nice. There are a variety of dishes in canteen like pasta, sandwiches, maggi, coffee, etc. There are four floors in total. There are many departments like psychology, English, etc.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Overall, you can consider the college for undergraduates.

content.Placements: Around 90% of the students got placed. The highest package offered is 12 LPA. There are many start-ups for entrepreneurial minds and internships are also available. With some hard work and dedication, you can easily grab an opportunity for both internships and placements.
content.Infrastructure: Hostels are available outside the campus which is owned by the college itself for both boys and girls separately. They are clean and well-managed by the college. Food quality is good and washrooms are also available. You do have options of PG nearby which are also affordable and accessible.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Good college and good facility.

content.Placements: So basically, this college provides internships and also placements for sales and marketing, and they also provide financing jobs, but they don't provide good packages. The lowest package will be up to 2.50 Lacs and the highest 6 to 8,00,000. HR jobs provided by the college are the best.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of my college is very advanced, and talking about the hostel, it is one of the best private hostels. Yes, it is expensive, but the facilities provided by them are amazing, like good food, Wi-Fi, washrooms, and cleanliness.

The Zoology Lab has a museum near it with a lot of dried and reserved insects and plants. There is a botanical garden maintained by the botany department. content.Placements: 98 percent of students got placed. The highest package is 86 lakhs per annum, the lowest package is 28 lakhs per annum, and the average package is 55 lakhs per annum. The top recruiting companies for our courses are Myntra, Google, Microsoft, etc. 85 to 90 percent of students got internships in Microsoft, a company. The top roles offered in our course are machine learning and some hardware-export courses.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is excellent, and the departments are well-designed. Wi-Fi facilities are available, and labs are provided, along with classrooms with Smart Boards and a library. Hostel facilities are good, providing food facilities in the mess, and medical facilities are available in emergency situations. They also provide sports and games to the students.

individual_reviews.course: Discontinued (Feb - 2022) M.Tech. in Structural Engineering - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: The best place for students to pursue research studies.

content.Placements: The placements were not the primary concern for many students in the college. Most of the students were interested in higher studies, but the trend is slightly changing. The faculty members provide very little help, and the rest has to be done by the students.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our department is not up to the mark. Labs need to be well-maintained. I think all the buildings should be maintained in the same way without bias.

content.Placements: In our college, the placement rate is pretty cool. Our teachers and faculty have great contacts in the media field for editing. Located at a lush green MGM campus, MGM College of Fine Art is popularly known as MGM COFA. It is a private college that was established in 2003. review_summary.college_name: Dev Bhoomi School of Engineering and Computing Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: This college is best for study, placement and facilities aur also good.

content.Placements: There are 90% of students who were placed in the B.Tech course this year. The highest package is 40 LPA, and the lowest package is 6 LPA in top companies like Swaraj, Mahindra, and Robbins.
content.Infrastructure: This is the best university in Dehradun, and the facilities are very good. The infrastructure of the college is good, with a 24-hour library, very good labs, classrooms, and facilities. Teaching quality is also very good, with approximately 6-7 years of experience. The hostel is also good, with very good rooms and food. Every year, they organise sports tournaments.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Good placements and facilities.

content.Placements: I will complete B.Tech in Computer Science (2025-2029). Around 75-80% students are placed. The highest package is about 20 LPA, the lowest 3 LPA, and the average is 6-7 LPA. Top recruiters are TCS, Infosys, Wipro, and Accenture. About 60% got internships as developers or analysts.
content.Infrastructure: The department has well-equipped labs, smart classrooms, good Wi-Fi, and a well-stocked library. Hostels are clean with basic facilities, decent food in the mess and canteen. Medical support on campus, and good sports facilities for indoor and outdoor games.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Dev Bhoomi School of Engineering, Dev Bhoomi Uttarakhand University review.

content.Placements: The bulk of hiring comes from mass recruiters like TCS, Wipro, Capgemini, and Infosys. If you have decent grades (no backlogs) and basic coding skills, you will likely get placed in one of these. The college does not hand hold you for internships. You have to be proactive and find them yourself, though they might help with the paperwork.
content.Infrastructure: The campus looks good from the outside. The computer labs are generally functional with working systems. A common complaint is Wi-Fi: while they claim campus-wide Wi-Fi, the speed and connectivity in hostel and certain blocks can be spotty. Hostels are decent and clean enough in the budget range. I will suggest to take PG outside.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure, supportive faculty, active campus life, and decent placements with growth.

content.Placements: Around 85% students got placed. The highest package is 18 LPA, the lowest is 3 LPA, and the average is 6 LPA. Top recruiters included TCS, Infosys, Wipro, and Accenture. About 70% got internships. Roles offered are Software Engineer, Analyst, and Developer, good for the students who have come.
content.Infrastructure: The department has smart classrooms, high-speed Wi-Fi, well-equipped labs, and a rich library. Hostels are clean and secure. Mess food is hygienic, and a canteen is available. Medical support, sports grounds, and indoor games facilities are provided wifiij.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Decent infrastructure, decent campus life. Average placements.

content.Placements: The placement performance of the batch was moderate. Around 75-80% of students from last year's batch were successfully placed through campus recruitment drives, while some opted for higher studies and off-campus opportunities for a skilled career path. For placement, there is aptitude training and interview preparation.
content.Infrastructure: The facility and infrastructure available for the course are decent. Wi-Fi is rather slow but okay. There is a library at the top. Classrooms contain projectors with whiteboards. Some contain smart boards. The quality of food available in the mess is not so good, but okay. There are vending machines in every hostel, so you don't have to go to the canteen. The canteen contains good quality food.

faqs.question: How much is the total BTech fee at Jagannath University Haryana?
faqs.answer: The total BTech fee in Jagannath University Haryana comes around INR 3.56 L to 5.4 L approximately The fee can be more or less depending on which specialisation student is taking. Also, tuition fee is generally paid at start of academic year. Apart from tuition fee, the total fee may include hostel charges, lab charges or other miscallenous charges.

faqs.question: Is pursuing MBA at Jagannath University Haryana expensive?
faqs.answer: If you belong to an upper-middle-class family then the expenses are not too much for you but if you belong to a lower-middle-class family then it can be a bit expensive for you. The first-year fee for MBA is approximately INR 1.15 lac. Also, if you are a residence of another state, then it can be really expensive for you. As you can't get a scholarship from your state. Although you can take scholarships offered by central organizations. But there are many criteria for that. Hope you find it helpful.

faqs.question: What is the fees for various courses at Jagannath University Haryana?
faqs.answer: As it is a private university fees of this university may be higher as compared to several Government university. For any bachelor/undergraduate programs like B.Tech, BBA, BCA, etc. the fees ranges from Rs.60,000 to Rs.1,20,000 and for master degree programme like M.Tech, MBA, MCA, etc. the fees ranges from Rs.80,000 to Rs.2,00000. It is the approximate fees of these course, You are adviced to contact with the college reception to get the exact fees structure of the different courses. The fees for professional courses like B.Tech, MBA tend to be higher than general degree courses, and there is a hike in fees of this university every year. If any students need to opt any hostel and mess facilitues they have to pay extra for that as they state to pay them.

faqs.question: What are extra charges included in BSc programme fee at Jagannath University, Haryana in 2025?
faqs.answer: The total Jagannath University Fee amount may include other charges, if applicable. A one-time admission payment is also charged by the university. Hostel charges if applicable is charged along with admission charges. Whereas, the total tuition fee is paid at the beginning of each academic year.

reviews.review_heading: The college infra and all things are good but canteen and hostel food is below average
reviews.review_text: The infra is good and labs are average in this university. There is free unlimited Wi-Fi, modern labs and a library in which we can issue books to use.

reviews.review_heading: A bachelor's degree in my life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. It has a Wi-Fi campus, AC classrooms, smart classes, and well-furnished labs for every subject. The canteen and Nestled cafeteria are provided on the campus. Annual sports are also organised at the university level every year.

reviews.review_heading: The education is good, but the infrastructure could be more good.
reviews.review_text: In my BPT course, we design machines related to our course, along with an OPD and labs for different subjects, such as the exercise therapy lab and anatomy lab. The college provides well-equipped hostels for both girls and boys, and there is a mess that provides three meals a day and snacks in the evening. The university annually organizes a sports meet, which lasts for three continuous days for intra-university students, along with various games.

reviews.review_heading: Jagannath - The best college.
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure is very good and reliable for both students and teachers. Our faculty members of Jagannath are very helpful and friendly with us. They help us a lot in our studies and even give us extra classes. I didn't opt for the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Fair exams and studies, but dissatisfied because of no activities and opportunities.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is not strong. The labs are okay and properly equipped. Classrooms have ACs that never work. The library never has the books needed. They neither have novels nor course-related books. Hostel food is okay. No AC in the hostels. Recently, they put coolers after so many complaints from students.

reviews.review_heading: JNU Jhajjar details about MPT course.
reviews.review_text: All facilities are available, including classrooms, laboratories, libraries, gyms, swimming pools, and Wi-Fi. The quality of the food in the mess is just okay, not great. Medical facilities are good; there are many labs for physiotherapy treatment. Sports and games are held annually there at the university.

reviews.review_heading: Life at Jagan Nath University.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the university is large enough. There are different buildings for the different courses. The classrooms are also good for 80–85 students. Wi-Fi is available in every corner of the university. The library is on two floors and around 900–1200 books are available in the library. The hostel facility is also available at the university and there are different buildings for girls and boys hostels. The food is good and they give 4 meals a day to the students that live in the hoste...

reviews.review_heading: I am very satisfied with faculty members of this college.
reviews.review_text: Hostel rooms are clean and the environment is also good. The food provided by the hostel staff is quite impressive and tasty. Cleaners are provided to clean the rooms before the students get back to the hostel. Warden of the hostel is good and very friendly with students.

reviews.review_heading: It is fruitful for a UG student due to its moderate fee structure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and facilities available on the campus are good. The campus has 3 labs and 1 library, and you can spend most of the time in the library and labs because students are allowed to avail it anytime. The college is far from Delhi, so it is very hectic for one to travel on a daily basis, but you can reside in the hostel provided.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Jagannath University Bahadurgarh.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi facility rarely worked on the campus, and we almost complained about it every day, and there was no response. Classrooms were good and well-designed, but the orientation of the structure is too bad. The campus is air-conditioned. Taking a journey for hours from Delhi to study is still a nightmare.

reviews.review_heading: I don't want to say anything.
reviews.review_text: No this university not provide us anything. They have a computer lab but without a computer they taking a designing classes but without a software also have a camera without a sensor. But faculty is too good no doubt on that part seriously they are the Best.

reviews.review_heading: Jagannath university is best for education.
reviews.review_text: Entire college is connected to a Wi-Fi network. All classrooms are fully air conditioned. And has also got a big sports ground with facility of all the sports and their is a gym also for fitness lovers. In the canteen the quality and taste of food is very good. And the hostels are very near to the university.

reviews.review_heading: Fully satisfied because of opportunities provided on-campus.
reviews.review_text: The campus is fully enabled with Wi-Fi. Labs are maintained properly as all the required labs for each department are available there. The library is always open for students, and even students have their library cards with which they can get books for some days. Quality food is served at the canteen. Infrastructure is very good.

reviews.review_heading: Once we were dissatisfied with them.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of campus is nice. They have two buildings in that they have separate department for course and cafeteria. Ground for volleyball. Basketball cricket n many more. They have a very nice hostel with good food n good facilities nice labs.

reviews.review_heading: Study is good in college.
reviews.review_text: All over building is okay. Classrooms are normal same as government colleges. Library is good. We get all the books which we required related to subjects. There is AC also in computer lab and library. There are two Computer lab. Quality is good. Canteen is not good. Only Small dairy products are there.

For any bachelor/undergraduate programs like B.Tech, BBA, BCA, etc. the fees ranges from Rs.60,000 to Rs.1,20,000 and for master degree programme like M.Tech, MBA, MCA, etc. the fees ranges from Rs.80,000 to Rs.2,00000. It is the approximate fees of these course, You are adviced to contact with the college reception to get the exact fees structure of the different courses.

The fees for professional courses like B.Tech, MBA tend to be higher than general degree courses, and there is a hike in fees of this university every year. If any students need to opt any hostel and mess facilitues they have to pay extra for that as they state to pay them.
To encourage its bright students, Jagannath University offers various categories of scholarships.

The merit-based scholarships for BCom students at Jagannath University, Haryana are awarded based on the candidate's performance in the qualifying examination (Class 12). The university has a tier system:
Students securing above 90% marks in Class 12 receive a 35% tuition fee scholarship.
Those scoring between 80% and 90% are eligible for a 25% tuition fee concession.
Students with scores ranging from 70% to 80% can avail a 10% tuition fee scholarship.
Even those with marks between 60% and 70% are granted a 5% tuition fee concession.

Based on the information available on the university official website the university follows the UGC guideline to refund the fees to the students. It is mentioned in the terms and condition of the refund ploicy of the University "4.1. 3 If a student chooses to withdraw from the programme of study in which he/she is enrolled, the institution concerned shall follow the following five-tier system for the refund of fees* remitted by the student" .
